name: Equatorial Maranhao Distribuidora de Energia S.A.
summary: Equatorial Maranhão Distribuidora de Energia S.A. provides electricity distribution services in the state of Maranhão. The company was formerly known as Companhia Energética do Maranhão – CEMAR. Equatorial Maranhão Distribuidora de Energia S.A. was founded in 1958 and is based in São Luís, Brazil.
